shots.line: A new day begins in Helsinki under the morning light.
At Pohjoinen Rautatiekatu 21, Yahoo News reported on November 10, 2026, that Wolt risks being shut down after a Road Safety Authority police complaint.
On November 10, 2026, The Jerusalem Post also reported that Wolt faces a police probe and potential shutdown over courier safety violations.
At Kaivokatu 10 A, PR Newswire reported on November 10, 2026, that Supermetrics launched Campaign Manager for AI-powered insights and campaign execution.
The briefing is complete. You can now explore the city.
